name: Compliance failure breakdown
description: Which settings are actually causing non-compliance, ranked by how many devices they affect.
note: The overview is always cheap, regardless of fleet size, because it reads a tenant-wide aggregate rather than walking devices one at a time. Drilling into a setting to see which devices are affected is also cheap. Fetching each device's actual failure reason is not - it is one Graph call per device and is opt-in, with its own cost shown before it runs.

fields.label: Platform
fields.hint: One platform per run, since a failing setting on one platform rarely means anything on another.

fields.label: Setting to drill into (optional)
fields.placeholder: Leave blank for the ranked overview only
fields.hint: Exact setting name, as shown in the overview. Lists which devices are affected - cheap, one call regardless of how many devices.

fields.label: Fetch each device's actual failure reason (needs a setting above)
fields.hint: One Graph call per affected device. A setting failing on thousands of devices means thousands of calls - only enable this once you have narrowed to one setting you actually need the reason for.

fields.label: Also write an interactive HTML report
